name: disable_selected_object_motion

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DisableSelectedObjectMotion queues operation type 16 without accessing the Script value stack; the object-operation dispatcher sets the motion-disable flag 0x200000000 in the selected object's flags at +0x440

notes: Operation type 16 maps to the embedded MOTION_OFF name. It sets the same disable flag that type 15 clears; 93 JP calls immediately follow command 338 disable_script_object_push.
